svg.title: The PUG rating ladder
svg.desc: Nine ranks in three tiers, from Rookie to Legend, set per season by staff. Tier B: Rookie, Prospect, Contender. Tier A: Challenger, Pro, Elite. Tier S: Star, All-Star, Legend. Thresholds: Rookie <1150, Prospect 1150+, Contender 1300+, Challenger 1450+, Pro 1600+, Elite 1750+, Star 1900+, All-Star 2050+, Legend 2200+. Ranks are Discord roles and change the moment your rating crosses a threshold; crossing into the next tier moves you up a tier.
